defining_characteristic: GTA's premier adult lifestyle gated community (55+) centered around an executive 9-hole golf course. Age-restricted. No children under 18 as permanent residents.

new_construction_range.note: 11 quick move-in homes available as of March 2026. Sizes vary.

resale_range.note: Condos from $299,900 (bachelor/studio) to $589,900 (2 bed/2 bath, ~1000 sq ft). Detached/bungalow resale up to $1,799,900.
resale_range.source: realtor.ca; zolo.ca May 2026 listings for Via Rosedale Way addresses

home_types_and_prices.entry_point: Studio/1-bed condos from ~$299,900 — one of the lowest entry points to a gated community in the GTA

clubhouse_indoor_amenities: Indoor heated swimming pool + aquafit classes

golf.description: Catered to both seasoned veterans and novice golfers
features: Pin and hole locations changed regularly
High standard of maintenance and care

green_spaces.description: 2 large parkettes with trees, gardens, walkways, and benches; all interconnected with pedestrian-friendly promenades
green_spaces.gardening: Community gardens — residents welcome to participate in planting and landscape enhancement; professional full-time maintenance team

security.concierge: Gatehouse concierge on duty during peak hours for guest entry

who_buys_here: Retirees selling family homes in Brampton/Mississauga/Toronto and downsizing into low-maintenance community
Semi-retirees (55+) wanting active lifestyle with golf, pool, and social programming
Empty nesters wanting security and community without leaving Brampton
Buyers who want to eliminate exterior maintenance — lawn, snow, landscaping all covered
South Asian retirees whose adult children live in Brampton neighbourhoods like Castlemore — proximity to family
maintenance_free_notes: Professional landscaping maintained by management. Exterior upkeep included in community fees. Residents describe it as 'maintenance-free' living.
schools: N/A — age-restricted 55+ community. No school catchment information relevant.
